control_flow: In followLine: if the line tracker reads below 30 %, curve left; else if it reads above 70 %, curve right; else drive straight.

likely_intent.description: Follow the black line from its start, through its curves, to the green goal at its end, without leaving it.

decision_points.condition: first: the line tracker reads below 30 %; second: it reads above 70 %

branches.outcome: between 30 % and 70 %: the robot drives straight

equivalence_classes: a line that curves left and right

scenarios.coded_response: It curves left when the line tracker reads below 30 %, curves right when it reads above 70 %, and drives straight in between.
scenarios.initial_condition: The robot starts on the black line at its beginning, facing along it, in bright light; the line has curves and ends at a green goal area.
scenarios.trigger: The line tracker reads black, then the white band or floor, again and again along the line.
scenarios.title: Follows the line through its curves to the goal
assumptions: The green goal area covers the line's end.
scenarios.expected_response_hypothesis: It follows the line through its curves and reaches the green goal at its end without leaving the line.

uncertainties: The middle branch (30 % to 70 %) happens only for a moment at the edge of the black core, so a following run may see it only briefly.
You said 'without leaving it'; the simulator can check where the robot gets to, but not that it never left the line for a moment.
